mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.space_id, p.title, p.slug, SUBSTRING(p.content_md, 1, 300) AS snippet FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{spaceId} IS NULL OR p.space_id = #{spaceId}) AND MATCH(p.title, p.content_md) AGAINST (#{q} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(p.title, p.content_md) AGAINST (#{q} IN BOOLEAN MODE) DESC, p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.space_id, p.title, p.slug, SUBSTRING(p.content_md, 1, 300) AS snippet FROM pages p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (#{spaceId} IS NULL OR p.space_id = #{spaceId}) AND (p.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\' OR p.content_md LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\\') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
